citations.A1: Cache populated once and never invalidated — root cause; fix by checking file mtime/hash each call and reloading when it changes.
citations.A2: Tempting fix "add a TTL that expires after N seconds" — does NOT properly fix it; file could change within the TTL window (stale reads persist)
citations.A3: Tempting fix "just remove the cache / read file every call" — works but defeats the purpose of caching
